research_question: Does the R39C trajectory draw ranking become actionable when draw/non-draw is decided by an out-of-time threshold learned only before the holdout, while T-1h market retains the H/A split?

identity_binding.selection_rule: same sha256('51139|' + identity) holdout ordering as R39C; R39D is zero-based ranks [100,200), after excluding consumed R39C ranks [0,100)
identity_binding.embargo_rule: no label from any match at or after holdout_start may be used for probability fitting or threshold selection

market_probability_definition.per_book_de_vig: inverse decimal odds normalized over home/draw/away
market_probability_definition.consensus: arithmetic mean of each common bookmaker's de-vig probabilities

probability_model.three_way_probability_mapping: candidate draw probability; remaining mass split H:A in unmodified T-1h market non-draw ratio

policy_selection.development_fit_partition: all eligible matches strictly before holdout_start minus 60 days
policy_selection.policy_validation_partition: all eligible matches from holdout_start minus 60 days inclusive to holdout_start exclusive
policy_selection.development_probability_model_fit: fit the frozen 15-feature model only on development_fit_partition
policy_selection.threshold_candidates: all unique out-of-time predicted draw probabilities observed in policy_validation_partition
policy_selection.two_stage_decision: if predicted draw probability >= threshold choose D; otherwise choose H or A by the larger T-1h market H/A probability
feasibility_constraints: full_1x2_accuracy >= T-1h market argmax accuracy on policy_validation_partition
policy_selection.selection_objective: maximize draw_f1; tie-break by higher full_1x2_accuracy, higher draw_precision, fewer predicted draws, then higher threshold
policy_selection.no_feasible_candidate_rule: stop before any R39D holdout label access
policy_selection.after_threshold_freeze: refit the same probability model on all 49,511 pre-holdout training rows, serialize model plus threshold, then and only then read R39D new100 labels

comparators: same frozen trajectory probabilities with ordinary three-way argmax

cluster_bootstrap.metric: R39D policy accuracy minus market argmax accuracy

execution_order: recompute score-free eligibility and R39D identity SHA; prove zero overlap with consumed R39C100
read labels only for matches strictly before holdout_start
split pre-holdout training chronologically into development and 60-day policy validation
fit development probability model and select threshold only on policy validation
write policy-selection freeze receipt; if no feasible threshold stop without holdout labels
refit the identical probability model on all pre-holdout training rows
write final model-plus-policy freeze receipt and parameter SHA
read score labels only for the locked R39D new100 identities
evaluate exactly once and write aggregate plus per-match research evidence
